title.en: Practice on animal and/or ex vivo models is useful to gain the basic ESD skills. ESGE recommends performing at least 20 ESD procedures in these models before human practice, with the goal of at least eight en bloc complete resections in the last 10 training cases, with no perforation.

statement.en: Practice on animal and/or ex vivo models is useful to gain the basic ESD skills.
